content.description: ### Maintain equipment and replace it when defective. Some equipment, such as slicers and mincers, must be regularly checked to ensure they operate safely and are adequately cleaned.
### Make sure pest control screens and refrigerators are working correctly to maintain the safety of the food you produce.
### Make sure equipment, such as weighing scales, is calibrated or adjusted to be reliable and accurate.
### Clean and sanitise probe thermometers before and after each use. When inserting a probe into food, clean and sanitise after checking each food item.

items.caption: ## Keeping a **clean kitchen** is everyone's responsibility.
## **Food safety** is critical to the success of your business, so keeping the kitchen clean (including fridges and freezers) is **not negotiable**.
## Sanitise the **benches** before and after use.
## Sweep and mop all **floors **and underneath **all equipment**.
## **Separate the food items** to avoid contamination—for example, separate meats from veggies and chillers.
## **Do not store personal items** above food items or preparation areas.
